concerns.text: Circular dependency violation: T014 (MMD detection) must calculate the Bonferroni threshold (p < 0.01/N) to flag results, but T015 is ordered AFTER T014 and explicitly states it must 'READ N from data/processed/mmd_config.json generated by T014'. The detector cannot flag results without N, yet N is only written after the run. T015 must precede T014 or the logic must be merged so N is calculated and applied within the same execution block before flags are written.

Missing artifact dependency: T014 (MMD detection) requires the preprocessed series (log-transformed, standardized) as input per FR-002 and FR-003. T013 (preprocessing) is listed after T014 in the task list. T013 must precede T014 to ensure the input artifact exists.

Missing artifact dependency: T017 (metrics calculation) requires the 'flags.csv' output from T015 and the 'ground_truth_events.csv' from T012b. While T012b is earlier, T015 is listed after T016. T016 (tolerance logic) and T017 (metrics) depend on the flags generated by T015. T015 must precede T016 and T017.

Missing artifact dependency: T026b (cross-comparison t-test) explicitly requires 'MMD delays (from data/processed/mmd_delays.json generated by T017)' and 'Baseline delays (from data/processed/baseline_delays.json generated by T026a)'. T026b is listed before T017 and T026a in the task sequence. T017 and T026a must precede T026b.
Missing artifact dependency: T031b (execute sensitivity grid) depends on the parameter combinations generated by T031a ('generate_grid()'). T031b is listed before T031a. T031a must precede T031b.
Missing artifact dependency: T010 (unit test for MMD) explicitly states it uses 'synthetic data from T008'. T010 is listed before T008. T008 must precede T010.

Missing artifact dependency: T011 (integration test) requires the full pipeline (data download, preprocessing, detection, evaluation) to be complete. It is listed before T012a/b and the implementation tasks T013-T018. T011 must be ordered after all implementation tasks it tests.

Missing artifact dependency: T024 (integrate baselines into main.py) requires the implementations of Pettitt (T022) and BOCPD (T023) to exist. T024 is listed before T022 and T023. T022 and T023 must precede T024.

Missing artifact dependency: T032 (aggregate metrics) requires the outputs from the sensitivity grid execution (T029, T030, T031b). T032 is listed before these execution tasks. T029, T030, and T031b must precede T032.
Missing artifact dependency: T018 (report generation) requires metrics from T017 and potentially baseline results. T018 is listed before T017. T017 must precede T018.
